name: sdf-badge
prompt: A rounded badge shape with an outline and soft drop shadow, transparent background. Corner radius and outline width sliders, fill and outline colors.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: I wrote the shader layer: a rounded badge with a fill, an outline and a soft drop shadow beneath it, on a transparent background. Controls: uRadius (corner radius, 0–1 of half the shorter side), uOutline (outline width, 0–40 px), uFill and uOutlineColor (colors), plus uShadowOpacity, uShadowBlur and uShadowOffset. I haven't compiled or rendered it because no live Powermove tools were attached, so the shadow could appear above the badge instead of below, depending on the layer's vertical direction.
